baseline_models.focus_anchor: The process noun at word 1, its definite Book complement at word 2, and the source chain at words 3-6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A conveyance event has a determinate object and an explicitly named origin. Strength makes the source able to deliver without being overruled, while right-knowing wisdom makes the delivery purposive rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and conveyance make the opening a transmission event rather than a bare label for an object.
Ordered letters and the resulting written object specify the stable thing being conveyed.
The divine name supplies the personal source pole governed by the preposition of origin.
Strength and inviolability give the source sufficient agency to secure the delivery.
Knowledge that reaches the right judgment makes the secured delivery discriminating and purposive.

changed_reading.after: The line profiles a controlled act of delivery whose named source guarantees both effective transmission and intelligent purpose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placement sense available to the process noun, the joining and decree senses of Book, and the paired source attributes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book is a joined and binding order; its sending-down places that order in an appropriate station. Reinforcement makes its parts hold, and wisdom both prevents disorder and secures workmanship.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station turns descent into calibrated placement.
Joining one part to another supplies the internal cohesion of the placed order.
A written fixing that obligates or decrees gives the joined order normative force.
Strengthening one element by another reinforces the Book's joined architecture.
Restraint that prevents corruption supplies the corrective boundary of the order.
Secure workmanship makes proper placement an engineered fit rather than mere location.

changed_reading.before: Sending-down names movement from a source to recipients.
changed_reading.after: Sending-down also reads as installing a cohesive, binding order in its fitting station, with force and restraint built into the installation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The hardship and contest branches of descent, the decree branch of Book, and the force-restraint pairing in the final attributes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book can enter a resistant field as an enforceable intervention. Its overpowering capacity is not loose violence: the wisdom complex checks, redirects, and reforms that force like a bridle.

activation_trace.role: A hardship that descends supplies the intervention's capacity to press upon its recipients.
Descending into contest supplies an adversarial field in which the message meets resistance.
The binding decree keeps the intervention anchored in the Book's normative force.
Overcoming and subduing supply the intervention's effective pressure.
Preventive restraint directs pressure toward stopping corruption and effecting repair.
The literal bridle image contains force by giving it steering and a limit.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is neutral transfer of information.
changed_reading.after: Revelation can be a forceful corrective entry into resistance, but its might is steered and bounded by wisdom.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate creation frame supplies measurement, a lower pole, an interspace, fitting truth, and a terminal measure. Read back into the focus, descent becomes the calibrated placement of a binding text inside an already measured spatial and temporal order.

activation_trace.role: Proper placement is the focus operation that the creation frame calibrates.
The fixed decree is the textual order being installed within the measured world.
Secure workmanship links the source attribute to exact fit.
Literal measuring and proportioning supply calibration as the adjacent creation operation.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies a landing pole for the focus descent axis.
The middle interval prevents the vertical model from collapsing into two points and gives placement an articulated field.
A right that fits its proper joint or vessel supplies exact spatial and normative fit.
A fixed temporal limit adds timing to the mechanism of proper placement.

structural_cues: 46:3 immediately expands from 46:2 into heavens, earth, their interspace, truth, and a named term.
The focus process noun is followed by a finite creation claim, moving from textual placement to world-order without an intervening topic break.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, a lower pole and middle interval, fitting truth, and a terminal measure; I project their spatial-temporal fit back onto the placement branch of descent. A live alternative is that 46:3 only describes creation while 46:2's attributes certify source competence without making text and cosmos structurally analogous.

changed_reading.before: The Book is delivered from a powerful and wise source.
changed_reading.after: Its delivery is a calibrated installation within the same measured, truth-fitted, time-bounded order that structures creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The source claim is placed into an evidentiary economy: rival claims are asked for a prior document or surviving trace of knowledge, witnesses are invoked, and the present Book confirms a predecessor. Bookness therefore makes origin inspectable rather than merely asserted.

activation_trace.role: A stable written object gives the focus provenance claim a form that can be produced, compared, and examined.
The named divine source is the provenance claim put under public test.
The demanded written object establishes a document as admissible counter-evidence.
A surviving mark that points back to what was supplies a second, material route for proving origin.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the epistemic standard for document and trace.
Testimony stated from knowledge adds an accountable witness to the provenance test.
Making a prior promise or claim come true supplies cross-document confirmation rather than isolated assertion.

structural_cues: 46:4 coordinates prior book, surviving trace, knowledge, and truthfulness inside one demand for proof.
46:8 adds witness, and 46:12 repeats Book in a predecessor-confirmation relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demanded documentary or trace evidence, knowledgeable witness, and confirmation; I infer that 'from God' is framed as publicly accountable provenance. The alternative is that these are later polemical tests that defend the claim without changing the semantic work of the focus source phrase.

changed_reading.before: From God is a bare assertion of origin.
changed_reading.after: From God is a provenance claim carried by a durable Book and placed in a public system of traces, witnesses, and cross-document confirmation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The delivered Book enters reception as an overt sign and clarifying disclosure, but it is covered by counter-labels of fabrication and later denied with knowledge. The encounter thus reveals the receiver's operation on evidence as well as disclosing content.

activation_trace.role: Conveyance brings the diagnostic object into an audience's field of response.
The stable Book keeps the competing reactions directed toward the same inspectable object.
An outwardly visible sign supplies the evidence presented to reception.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign makes obscurity an inadequate explanation for rejection.
Covering the truth supplies the receiver-side operation that counters disclosure.
Fabricating a lie supplies the counter-label by which a disclosed sign is redescribed.
Denial accompanied by knowledge closes the diagnostic sequence by distinguishing nonrecognition from resisted recognition.

structural_cues: Across 46:7-8, the same disclosed material is successively called clear, magic, and fabricated.
46:26 returns to signs after listing receptive faculties, then names knowing denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overt signs, semantic disclosure, covering, a fabrication label, and knowing denial; I infer that the Book functions as a diagnostic reagent that exposes reception. The live alternative is that the context only describes hearers and leaves the focus Book as a neutral message.

changed_reading.before: The Book's descent transfers content to an audience.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival also differentiates disclosure from covering: the Book makes the receiver's handling of evidence visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The binding Book and judicial wisdom become an operative settlement architecture. Acceptance and passing over coexist with graded outcomes, full return for acts, and protection from misplacement, so exactness includes calibrated clemency rather than simple severity.

activation_trace.role: The fixed and obligating decree supplies the normative record against which settlement occurs.
Judgment between parties turns wisdom from general intelligence into adjudicative capacity.
Receiving with approval supplies the positive intake side of settlement.
Passing beyond liability and leaving blame supplies deliberate clemency within the accounting.
Proceeding degree by degree supplies a graduated rather than binary outcome structure.
Purposive acts supply the concrete entries that the settlement evaluates and returns.
Completion without shortfall supplies exact discharge of what the acts entail.
Wrongly placing something outside its time or position defines the error that calibrated judgment excludes.

structural_cues: 46:16 pairs accepting the best with passing over bad acts; 46:19 then pairs degrees with full settlement and no wrong.
The sequence holds mercy and precision together instead of assigning them to separate systems.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceptance, waived liability, grades, acts, full payment, and exclusion of misplacement; I infer that the focus Book is the operative norm or ledger joining these operations. Alternatively, the Book may only announce a later judgment rather than function as its accounting instrument.

changed_reading.before: The Book is an authoritative decree from a judge.
changed_reading.after: The Book reads as a balanced settlement architecture in which wise exactness can grade, repay, accept, and deliberately pass over.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivery becomes a relay: receivers understand recitation, suspend their own speech, wait for completion, turn back, warn their community, issue a call, and seek an answer. The vertical source-to-Book relation therefore generates a horizontal receiver-to-receiver transmission chain.

activation_trace.role: Conveyance supplies the first leg of a transmission that the later audience continues.
The Book supplies the stable payload that can move through multiple receivers.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns acoustic reception into uptake.
Reading and recitation give the Book an audible, repeatable transmission mode.
Attentive silence supplies the receptive gate that prevents competing speech from interrupting uptake.
Completion marks a bounded listening event after which relay can begin.
Turning away supplies the physical pivot from receiving toward carrying the message back.
Warning that awakens caution is the transformed output produced by the receivers.
Answering speech closes the relay as an expected response rather than passive exposure.
A verbal call that inclines another supplies the interpersonal link between warning and answer.

structural_cues: 46:29 presents a strict sequence of hearing, commanded silence, completion, turning, and warning.
46:31 converts the returned warning into a call-and-answer relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full receive-complete-return-warn-call-answer sequence; I treat the receivers' return as a continuation of the focus descent along a new axis. The alternative is that this is only narrative aftermath and that descent remains exclusively source-to-messenger.

changed_reading.before: Sending-down is a one-way vertical transfer ending when the Book reaches its first audience.
changed_reading.after: Sending-down initiates a relay in which attentive receivers become horizontal carriers and recruit answering receivers of their own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later restatement joins sent-down Book, confirmation, relation to what precedes, guidance, truth, and an extended path. Proper placement now has a navigational effect: it installs a connected corridor through which recipients can move.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its fitting station supplies route installation rather than mere arrival.
Joining parts supplies continuity across the installed route.
The bridle's literal steering and restraint supply a contained directional function for wisdom.
A joined Book supplies the route's continuous textual medium.
The explicit later conveyance repeats the focus event and ties the route reading directly back to descent.
Realized confirmation connects the new segment to what precedes rather than replacing it.
A relation holding between endpoints supplies connective tissue across predecessor and present Book.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the route's steering function.
A right that matches its joint or container supplies the fitted destination of guidance.
The extended track gives the changed reading its literal traversable corridor.

structural_cues: 46:30 nearly restates the focus Book-and-descent pair, then immediately assigns confirmation, guidance, truth, and straight path.
The before-relation makes the path serial: it has inherited and present segments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sent-down Book, predecessor-link, guidance, fitted truth, and extended track; I infer that descent installs a navigable corridor and that wisdom steers within it. A live alternative is that the Book only points toward an independently existing path rather than constituting route infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The Book is placed before recipients as a completed object.
changed_reading.after: The Book's placement creates a connected, inherited route whose textual continuity guides movement toward a fitted truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because prepared guest-provision is form-distant from the focus process noun. It remains anchored in the supplied descent-root inventory and in the explicit source-object chain, while the written-object citation prevents literal replacement of Book by food. Downstream prose should present it only as a hospitality analogy: revelation as something prepared for a receiver willing to enter as guest.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prepared-provision branch of the descent root at word 1, constrained by Book at word 2 and the source attributes.

activation_trace.role: Prepared lodging or provision for an arriving guest supplies the hospitality analogy for what is sent.
The written object constrains the provision to nourishment by a Book rather than literal food.
The named source occupies the host or provider pole without erasing the focus grammar of origin.
Rarity and difficult attainment make the offered provision precious rather than commonplace.
Knowledge that reaches what is right characterizes the provision as fitted to genuine need.

changed_reading.before: The Book is information dispatched from a source.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Book is also prepared reception-provision: an offered lodging for thought whose benefit appears when the recipient enters.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation because 46:15's pregnancy, delivery, and weaning describe a human life, not revelation. It remains worth carrying because the focus uses a delivery process, Book has a joining branch, 46:12 places books in a prior-confirming relation, and 46:30 explicitly marks a later sent-down Book. Render only as a gestational or lineage analogy for staged transmission, never as a lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The delivery process at word 1 and the joining branch of Book at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies the focus-side event that the gestational sequence analogically elaborates.
Joining parts supplies continuity across stages and generations of text.
Temporal precedence supplies an earlier textual generation.
Two Book occurrences joined in one predecessor-present relation supply lineage continuity.
Realizing and confirming what preceded makes succession preserve rather than sever inheritance.
Inner carrying and fruit supply the hidden maturation stage of the analogy.
Delivering a carried burden supplies emergence into accessible form.
Weaning and separation supply staged independence after delivery.
Later-than-prior ordering closes the lineage mechanism with an explicit successor position.

changed_reading.before: The Book descends as a finished object in a single event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its delivery can be heard as staged textual generation: carried, brought forth, articulated into independent parts, and joined to an inherited line.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets an atmospheric episode reactivate marginal rain, hardship, and flood branches in the focus roots. It remains anchored by the descent root and the Mighty-Wise attributes, while 46:24-25 supplies the mistaken cloud, punitive rain, forceful wind, haste, and destructive outcome. Downstream prose must say the Book's arrival is analogous to a misclassified storm, not that revelation is the destructive wind.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hardship and guest-provision branches of descent at word 1, the severe-rain branch of Mighty, and corrective restraint in Wise.

activation_trace.role: Expected provision for an arrival supplies the beneficial classification initially projected onto what approaches.
A hardship that descends supplies the opposed valence hidden within an arrival.
Severe rain and overpowering flood give Mighty an atmospheric force-image.
Restraint for correction keeps force purposive within the analogy.
A cloud appearing from one side supplies an ambiguous visible arrival that invites classification.
Rain descending as punishment reverses the expected beneficial reading of the cloud.
Haste supplies the receiver-side cause of premature misclassification.
Wind as force and dominance realizes the overpowering side of the focus attribute.
Root-level annihilation supplies the consequence that exposes the original reading of the arrival as mistaken.

changed_reading.before: A descending gift is recognizable by a welcome outward form.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Book's arrival is double-edged and diagnostic: an approaching provision may be misclassified, while Mighty-Wise names force whose true function is disclosed by its effects.

strongest_changes: The creation frame turns sending-down into calibrated placement inside a truth-fitted and time-bounded order.
Document, trace, witness, and confirmation turn divine origin from bare assertion into publicly accountable provenance.
Acceptance, waiver, grading, and full return turn the binding Book into a balanced accounting architecture.
Attentive hearing, return, warning, call, and answer extend vertical descent into a horizontal receiver relay.
The direct restatement in 46:30 makes the placed Book navigational: it connects inherited segments and guides along an extended path.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive latent coupling was proper placement in descent with joining and decree in Book. Context split that coupling into several coexisting mechanisms rather than one theme: cosmic calibration, evidentiary provenance, reception diagnosis, balanced settlement, relay, and route. Hospitality, gestation, and storm remained live only with explicit branch-distance containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Proper placement may be a productive branch activation without being the dominant sense of the focus process noun.
The Mighty and Wise may simply qualify the source; several models infer that their force and restraint also characterize the delivery's operation.
Reception as diagnosis may describe the audience's behavior without changing what Book or sending-down means in 46:2.
The hospitality, gestational, and storm readings are cross-domain analogies and should not be rendered as lexical paraphrases.
